about: The art kit (OP-229): seamless textures and keyed shape sheets the level assembler (OP-234) builds screens from. Texture keys are kit-tex-<name>, 512 x 512, tileable. A sheet key is kit-sheet-<name>: one 2048 x 1152 painting on the key colour, six props in a grid of three across and two down, cut by `art:finish pieces` into the pieces listed here in reading order, each shipped as kit-<piece> at its logical size (w x h, 1x and 2x) with its alpha. tools/art/README.md describes the format.
palette: bark #2B1C12 to #4A3322, inner wood #5C4632 to #8F8068, moss #3E5A3A and #6E8B4E, leaf #4F7A3E and #8DAE5A, lantern gold #C9A227 and #FFD36A, cream #F6F1E3, navy #0C1E36 to #07122A, dusk blue #2E4C7A, sky blue #6F9BC8
